snippet.title: WHY SEX ISN'T ENJOYABLE FOR YOU
snippet.description:
I was shocked to learn that in some studies, up to 27% of people on birth control report a decrease in their libido or sex drive.

And yet, how many people are ACTUALLY talking about this?

That’s why today I’m sitting down with Dr Rachel Rubin.

Rachel is a board-certified urologist and sexual medicine specialist and one of ONLY 80 doctors in the US trained to treat both male and female sexual health.

Before we started recording, Rachel said “I’m filled with rage”…

She explained that people are being denied basic information about their bodies, hormones, sexual health and the treatments that could improve their quality of life…

I said to Rachel in this conversation that it’s staggering that so many women are still being let down by the medical system. It makes you think - if men were in this exact situation, would this be the case?

We discussed things like:

- Why so many women are told their symptoms are normal when they are actually treatable.
- Why Testosterone is not just a male hormone.
- How hormones can affect UTIs, libido, pain during sex and overall quality of life.
- If doctors are properly trained in women’s sexual health.
- Why men need to understand the main topic of this episode too.

What became clear to me is that this isn’t just a conversation about sex. It’s about health, relationships, confidence, ageing, pain, shame and the way people feel in their own bodies.

At the end of the conversation I told Rachel that there are very few people who have her credibility and experience, with her ability to explain these subjects in a way people can actually understand.

For anyone who wants to better understand their own body, or better understand someone they love - I really recommend watching this conversation.

snippet.title: ₹1.6 Lakh Crore Vanished - What REALLY Happened? #banks #scam #education #finance
snippet.description:
India’s biggest banking scams have crossed ₹1.6 lakh crore — but the real damage doesn’t stop at fraud headlines.
From PNB–Nirav Modi to DHFL, IL&FS, ABG Shipyard and SREI, these scams quietly slow credit growth, freeze lending, hurt MSMEs, delay projects, and impact jobs.

Banks often say “full provisioning done,” but provisioning means money locked, not recovered — leading to tighter loans and economic slowdown.
This video explains why bank scams keep repeating, how incentives are misaligned, and why every major fraud acts like a hidden tax on India’s economy.  #ChaiPeEconomics-7

Watch till the end to understand how banking frauds affect growth, jobs, and your money — even if you never took a loan.

snippet.title: USS Cole: Hunting the Mastermind Behind the Deadly Attack | CIA Declassified | FD History
snippet.description:
CIA Declassified - Episode 9: The Hunt for the Bombers | History Documentary

Watch 'CIA Declassidfied - Episode 10' here: https://youtu.be/lLj1x5J1iJs

In this episode:
When a terrorist bombing tore through the USS Cole in the Yemeni port of Aden in October 2000, 17 American sailors lost their lives and dozens more were injured. The attack exposed the growing threat posed by Al-Qaeda and signaled a new era of international terrorism.

In the aftermath, the CIA launched a years-long hunt for the men responsible. From the streets of Yemen to the highest levels of Al-Qaeda, intelligence officers pieced together a complex web of conspirators, safe houses, and covert networks. Through first-hand accounts and declassified information, this episode reveals the covert pursuit of the masterminds behind one of the deadliest terrorist attacks against the United States before 9/11.

The series:
These are the inside stories of America's most top secret covert operations. They involve assassins, deep undercover agents and the CIA's ultra-secret special black ops division. Each film is based upon the CIA's own documents and insider accounts from agents who were there. They show how America's spymasters tracked down and eliminated their nation's enemies.

snippet.title: The Rich Are Going Bankrupt — And It’s Accelerating
snippet.description:
The ultra-wealthy are going broke at record rates, and it's not because they're buying too many yachts. For the first time in decades, we're witnessing a silent financial massacre among the 1% as entire fortunes evaporate in months. From the "buy, borrow, die" strategy turning into a death trap when interest rates skyrocketed from 0% to 7%, to the commercial real estate apocalypse wiping out trillions in equity, the rules of wealth have fundamentally changed overnight. This isn't a moral story about greed—it's a mechanical breakdown of how leverage, illiquidity, and rising costs are systematically destroying generational wealth. We break down the exact mechanisms: how a 50-million-dollar net worth can vanish through margin calls, why office buildings that sold for $300 million now go for $60 million, and how the cost of simply maintaining an elite lifestyle has exploded by 100% in just three years.

But here's why this matters to everyone, not just the wealthy: they're the canaries in the coal mine. When the rich stop spending, service economies contract. When investors pull back, startups die and jobs vanish. When landlords default on commercial properties, regional banks face crisis—and your deposits are in those banks. This video reveals the early warning signs of a broader economic shift driven by rising interest rates, collapsing real estate markets, the end of free money, and aggressive tax policy changes. Whether you're building wealth or protecting what you have, understanding these forces isn't optional anymore. The financial weather is changing fast, and the lessons from the rich recession apply to everyone trying to survive what's coming next.

---
